data.name: [🏎️] Create a Car [ALPHA]
data.description:
🏎️ WELCOME TO CREATE A CAR!

🎰 Unbox crates and collect rare car parts
🔧 Build unique cars from Frames, Engines & Wheels
💸 Earn cash from your cars — even while offline
🏠 Show off your best cars in your Showroom
⭐ Prestige for better buffs and cooler Showrooms
🏁 Race other players and climb the Ranked leaderboard
🎟️ Earn exclusive rewards through each Season Pass

Build. Collect. Race. Flex. 🏆
